about_the_game:
A narrative text adventure set in a criminal syndicate.
For 21 days, you will face trials of money, trust, and betrayal.

You play a young man with ideals, trapped by deception.
To survive, you must learn the art of fraud under your trainer’s watch, complete tasks, and carve your path through daily conversations.

…But things won’t be so simple.
This world knows you exist.
Every word, every choice, will shape others’ trust in you—and define who you become.

Save yourself, sacrifice others, escape the syndicate, or become part of the system—
The ending is yours to write.

Features

  • Psychological “Battle” System – A turn-based design where victory comes through words; outsmart, deceive, or persuade your opponent in high-stakes dialogue showdowns.

  • Branching Paths & Endings – Will you be a victim, a survivor, or a cog in the machine? Your story unfolds across multiple outcomes.

  • A World of Contrasts – Walk through ordinary streets, endure suffocating offices, and feel the tension between daily life and hidden despair.

Notes

Now Hiring is not a horror game in the traditional sense, but its themes and story may provoke discomfort or intense emotions.
